announcement.titleZh: 记得闪卡 v3.0.0 更新
announcement.contentZh:
【新增】Agent 制卡。首页右上角进入，选好牌组和笔记类型后用对话直接出卡；支持普通题、填空题和导入牌组的自定义笔记类型，一次可生成多张可编辑草稿，改完再保存。

【新增】Agent 改卡。三个入口：首页右上角改任意卡片；闪卡学习页右上角「Agent 改卡」改当前这张；浏览页勾选卡片后批量改。字段、标签和牌组都能用对话修改，删除、改模板等高风险操作会列出影响范围并要求二次确认。

【新增】AI 设置收进设置页。可选 DeepSeek 或自定义接口，密钥加密保存在本机，只有你发送消息时才连接。

【新增】云端牌组下载、官方公告与 AnkiWeb 使用引导，并统一整理了各处界面细节。更多牌组可加入官方 QQ 群 726837065 获取。
announcement.contentEn:
[New] Agent Card Creation. Open it from the top-right menu on Home, pick a deck and note type, then describe what you want. Basic, cloze, and imported custom note types are supported, and one request can produce several editable drafts you review before saving.

[New] Agent Card Editing, with three entries: the top-right menu on Home for any card, "Agent Edit Cards" at the top right of the study screen for the card you are on, and multi-select in Browser for batches. Change fields, tags, and decks by conversation; deletions and template changes list their exact impact and ask for a second confirmation.

[New] AI setup lives in Settings, with DeepSeek or a custom endpoint to choose from. Keys stay encrypted on the device, and the provider is contacted only after you send a request.

[New] Cloud deck downloads, official announcements, and AnkiWeb guidance, plus a pass of interface polish throughout. Join the official QQ group 726837065 for more decks.
